2603935618.annotation: Good if you just need a cheap antiheal and if no one else is buying it its good to get since they dont stack with other Healbanes.

2447176615.annotation: Extra move speed, good for rotations and escapes.

2163598980.annotation: Check Incoming damage and if mostly Spirit, buy this. Keep in mind that Spirit Shielding is a lot of shield on its own. Enchanter's Emblem is a cheaper alternative.

3270001687.annotation: The best movement item in the game in my opinion. Short cooldown, instant teleport, and bullet resist. This lets you hit your Vitality spike which is a HUGE buff to health.

380806748.annotation: Really need those ults, interchangeable with Improved Spirit or Torment Pulse timing-wise.

2951612397.annotation: If you just wanna say I hate you to the person you're ulting. Kind of presses you for slots though.

395944548.annotation: Large source of your damage and helps with farm, lane clear, and tick dmg overall. Can rush Compress Cooldown here if your ult just went on cooldown.

3261353684.annotation: First item from Late Game that I typically get. Shortens all your cooldowns for more Burrows and Sandblasts. Get another armor!!!!!

7409189.annotation: Typically need this in order to proc Tankbuster but if you're insane and managed to get that many Spirit buffs from Golden Statues then go crazy and skip it.

2121044373.annotation: Consistent 15% of your damage by end game. Obviously does more damage to higher health targets so prioritize them if just looking for heals. You need 165 Scorn damage to proc this.

915014646.annotation: Buy if you have full active slots since this will lower the cooldown on them.

3812615317.annotation: Good for slow and the fact it completely stops movement and casting movement abilities. Makes proccing Spirit Burn trivially easy. MORE CC IS SUPER GOOD.

2717651715.annotation: Good item for just about everything right now, but the downside is your spin gets increased too, and that can hurt you in some situations. Good if your team needs an ult bot.

2417568017.annotation: AMAZING active item that gives huge spirit resist, and more AOE damage. Kind of presses you for active slots but well worth it for the extra percentage-based damage.

4204808176.annotation: Great if they are punch heavy players, or for Viscous Punches. Buy if not confident in parries too.

2922054143.annotation: Vs double M1 lanes this is pretty good. They keep buffing it. IT HAS TO BE GOOD EVENTUALLY

3074274290.annotation: Probably only good if you are very ahead, or you are behind AND your OTHER LANES are ahead. You must run around fighting pretty consistently to get value.

3731635960.annotation: Good item but you're so desperate for Active Slots it's hard to use sometimes, but some games it's just necessary to get.

3357231760.annotation: Great item for if they keep stunning you out of Ult or Burrow. Good knockup counter too.

3361811174.annotation: Get if you need that extra umfph to get away for escapes. Also good for securing that ult kill if they keep blowing you up before they die.

1047818222.annotation: This is now a very good item that is cheap and helps vs Crowd Control

1955841979.annotation: Great against Lash, Talon, or anyone with super high spirit burst. Solid resists for countering debuff characters. If taking stupid amounts of spirit damage, get Witchmail as well.

3028234315.annotation: Good for against FULL spirit teams, really a necessity buy if pressed for slots. Good against Infernus, Bebop, Geist, Lash etc.

630839635.annotation: Can imbue either Scorn or Burrow depending on enemy team comp. Imbue Scorn if you are surviving fights for a long time, imbue burrow if you are getting pulled out of burrow or dying quickly out of it

3005970438.annotation: This is what allows your damage to scale late game if they're buying resists, but it is not completely necessary. Very nice against spirit heavy comps. Works best with Spirit Burn.

2617435668.annotation: I find myself buying Cursed Relic a lot just because there's so many things worth cancelling, and Knockdown just isn't fast enough. THIS LOWERS YOUR DAMAGE. GO IF PLAYING TANKY.

343572757.annotation: Late game you're able to proc this with just a Burrow & Scorn so this has some potential as a strong antiheal. Works best with Escalating Exposure.

2519598785.annotation: This should literally be the LAST item you buy, like literally full build upgrade kind of item.

1371725689.annotation: Instant gap closer and a disarm, perfect for fliers/Lash since it has crazy range. Most expensive of the options, and not good for escapes.

865958998.annotation: Can go invis for sneaky combo's, also has very good healing uptime with Transcendent Cooldown. You can rush this before the other 3.2k soul items if you are roaming around

1378931225.annotation: Very very strong into fed M1 carries, insane uptime with Sup. Duration and Trans. Cooldown when alternated with Burrow.

1250307611.annotation: Great counter buy to gun heroes and melee spammers, but on its own won't protect you. AMAZING into Ricochet users.

1644605047.annotation: Bebop hard counter item. Good for dealing with stun heavy lanes that you are struggling to avoid.

3491236900.annotation: Probably the best possible item for dealing with gun heroes. Especially for the ones that apply effects. Bullet Resilience is a cheaper alternative.

3140772621.annotation: Buy when needed, can buy at any point in the game. Generally bullet resist is less needed than spirit resist because of burrow. But if you are getting pulled out of burrow consistently may be needed.

3361075077.annotation: The cost of this item is a bait, this is a mid-late game counter item for a team of 3+ M1 carries.

1254091416.annotation: Buy into ults you need to stun but can't get close enough to Cursed Relic them.

3144988365.annotation: Newly buffed and does a very large amount of damage, though slowly. It is also the best anti-heal other than Spirit Burn

3585132399.annotation: Still good some games while ahead, allows you to stay on map and continue pressuring. Not great when behind since you are more likely to be close to base anyways

619484391.annotation: Tempo Spirit Sap into mid game Silence Wave may be strong now

1662311306.annotation: A good counter to Wraith/Pocket ults. It's the only cleanse item in the game that can remove negative effects from ultimates. Buy it if you're relying on one Carry especially, SPAM it on them.

2820116164.annotation: An item to buy if you are weaker and want your ults to be better. Cheaper, but worse, than getting Unstoppable and Cheat Death

2566692615.annotation: Similar in value to Quicksilver Reload, but less damage and less healing depending on how much Anti-heal is on you

2947183272.annotation: averages to same healing as spirit lifesteal for double the prices, might get more value in low elo when entire team will just sit next to you but idk

2095565695.annotation: I know you may want to try out 'GunMo' but its generally just worse than spirit in every possible way, any gun card is just statistically worse than its spirit alternatives

2800629741.annotation: Playstyle choice item, potential as a gap closer and escape tool, but outperformed in both stats by items that specialize in those. Hi Loretze.

1414319208.annotation: Based on damage BEFORE resistances, so if you have a bunch of Bullet/Spirit Resist you will have max stacks constantly

1414025773.annotation: Great item in theory, but it takes a lot of practice to be good at. Perfect counter to Lash/Pocket/Calico and just about anyone with a delayed acting ability. Doesn't work in Burrow.

3919289022.annotation: Buy this if you're out of slots or have nowhere else to spend your souls

1235347618.annotation: Not a huge fan of Bullet Resist early, but if your burrow cooldown is being abused then this can be a good item to help

754480263.annotation: it seems bad but you will hit scorns you would've never dreamt of hitting without it, builds into greater expansion

3970837787.annotation: 15% spirit resist is super needed, +2 regen, and a good bit of extra spirit power most of the time, sameish value to spirit lifesteal, 5% cd helps with recent mo nerfs

1009965641.annotation: Great item for if getting poked out while clearing waves and for tower diving. Buy first item if getting attacked super hard in lane and stuck behind shop.

1710079648.annotation: if your lane partner or you r kinda selling, i cant think of a use case for me, but i always buy it when im trying out a new character for the first time so here it is

876563814.annotation: very good healing, cheap and better than healing booster and radiant regen, can sell later or maybe upgrade to infuser depending on how much antiheal is on you

1193964439.annotation: The Palmer Principle states that the overwhelming majority of Mo and Krill Combos are not improved by the addition of superior duration OR improved duration.

2081037738.annotation: used instead of extra spirit as it can also proc tankbuster, teamwide damage, and gives spirit resist. Saving 6.4k and a slot without boundless

334300056.annotation: You might need this is Mina keeps breaking your legs with maxxed Love Bites

1932939246.annotation: Good for more damage on towers, and for defending a lane or teamfights, but you are already good at defending lanes.

1150006784.annotation: This does not increase the damage or duration of Burrow. Pretty much only has value on Combo. Not a fan of the item.

112198670.annotation: Great buy in current meta, huge amount of shielding against spirit users. Perfect buy into double spirit spam lanes.

2829638276.annotation: Buy if you really are struggling to hold lane, but it will become a stall lane most likely. Best when unable to hit Scorns whatsoever.

4139877411.annotation: Necessary buy against anyone who can remove a stamina like Warden. Good buy as well if you don't have good stamina management or are building into Arcane Surge.

2061878743.annotation: Great item for dealing with gun heroes that are insanely oppressive. Only worth getting if a lot of disarm targets.

1798666702.annotation: Sell veilwalker for this at super full build

3294954488.annotation: If Krill's gun does get buffed at some point to being good, this will be a very good item to imbue onto Scorn
